tools.description: Compile source code and return assembly output, stdout, and stderr

tools.name: list_compilers
tools.description: List available compilers, optionally filtered by language

tools.description: List supported languages. Each entry has `defaultCompiler` and `compilerCount`.

tools.description: List available libraries for a given programming language

tools.description: Create a Compiler Explorer short URL for sharing code with compiler settings

Multi-pane shortlinks (executors, conformance views, CMake trees, per-compiler filters/tools) are flattened — only the basic compile
